versions.subject: Merge PR #4843 from @frack113 - Add `New-NetFirewallRule` usage related rules
versions.detection:
selection_name:
    - Image|endswith:
          - '\powershell.exe'
          - '\pwsh.exe'
          - '\powershell_ise.exe'
    - OriginalFileName:
          - 'PowerShell.EXE'
          - 'pwsh.dll'
selection_args:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'New-NetFirewallRule '
        - ' -Action '
        - 'allow'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\powershell.exe", "*\\pwsh.exe", "*\\powershell_ise.exe") OR OriginalFileName IN ("PowerShell.EXE", "pwsh.dll") CommandLine="*New-NetFirewallRule *" CommandLine="* -Action *" CommandLine="*allow*"
